exposure: Universal urine drug screening (UDS) with rapid confirmation (RC) via liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC-MS)
outcome: Rate of neonates observed for Neonatal Opioid Withdrawal Syndrome (NOWS)
cohort: All pregnant women admitted to a labor and delivery unit before (Phase 1: April 2018-March 2019) and after (Phase 2: October 2019-September 2020) the initiation of rapid confirmation for UDS.
finding: Universal UDS with rapid confirmation via LC-MS in labor and delivery may improve the detection of unanticipated positive mothers whose infants are at risk of NOWS, allowing intervention only for confirmed cases.
